# Своя игра (Svoya Igra)

> Free, open-source (MIT), self-hosted Jeopardy!-style quiz game for a group in one room or on one local network. A Go server runs many games; players buzz in from phones, computers or a web browser; a host judges; a TV, projector or Android TV shows the board. No accounts, no cloud, no database server. Interface in Russian.

Key facts:

- Roles: player, host, admin, screen. Each game has a 6-digit PIN and a share link `/g/<PIN>`.
- Fair buzzer: the answer button opens on all devices at once; per-player latency is measured and can be compensated.
- Rules: rounds × up to 10 categories × values; special questions (cat in the bag, auction, no-risk, double); a final round with bets.
- Question packs are `.dub` files: a ZIP of `pack.sqlite` + `media/` (images, audio, video). They can be written in the built-in editor or generated by a script or an AI assistant.
- Clients: Vue 3 web site, Flutter app for Android/Windows/Linux/macOS, Flutter Android TV app. LAN discovery over UDP.
- Run: `docker compose up -d --build` → `http://<ip>:3050`. Prebuilt apps on GitHub Releases.
- Repository: https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra/blob/main/docs/en/01-introduction.md): what the game is, roles, clients, storage
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra/blob/main/docs/en/03-getting-started.md): configuration, Docker, MikroTik, app builds
- [Game rules and packs](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra/blob/main/docs/en/07-game-and-packs.md): settings, phases, special questions, final, writing questions
- [Pack file format](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra/blob/main/docs/en/13-pack-format.md): how to generate `.dub` packs, SQLite schema, media rules, reference generator
- [Protocol](https://github.com/Namikko-chad/svoy-igra/blob/main/docs/en/05-protocol.md): REST, WebSocket, game JSON, LAN discovery (authoritative)
